description: React component for user registration screen, including form validation, phone input, and navigation logic.

methods.name: onCompleted
methods.description: Handles the result of the phone existence check mutation, navigates to email verification if phone is unique.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Handles errors from the phone existence check mutation.

methods.name: handleBackNavigation
methods.description: Navigates back to the login page when the user navigates back.

methods.name: handleClickShowPassword
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of the password input.

methods.name: handleMouseDownPassword
methods.description: Prevents default mouse down behavior on password toggle button.

methods.name: handleAction
methods.description: Validates form inputs and triggers phone existence check mutation.

methods.name: toggleSnackbar
methods.description: Clears the error message to close the snackbar.
